zones.name: The Daozang — the Daoist Canon
zones.subtitle: 道藏 · ~1,500 texts · mostly untranslated
zones.blurb: The Ming Zhengtong Daozang (1445) holds ~1,500 texts in ~5,300 scrolls — the overwhelming majority never translated into English (the Daoist parallel to the Tengyur). Shown by structure; no open catalogue exists (the Schipper–Verellen index is ©).
